contracts.statement: Decision evaluates only on the fixed eligible clock and never backfills a closed interval.
Decision continues with the last valid model while Training is blocked or unavailable.
Decision and outcome evidence is immutable and append-only.
The NOT_DUE gate executes before expensive training materialization or reconstruction.
Training materialization advances with bounded pages and a durable checkpoint.
Critical status never scans growing history and remains independently bounded.
Dashboard Sync attempts the critical heartbeat before optional or growing resources.
An optional Sync resource failure degrades only that resource and does not invalidate the critical heartbeat.
Cloudflare unavailability does not stop local Decision or Evidence append.
Stable changes only through explicit local Promote or Reverse after exact candidate validation.
The installed Control Plane bundle and heartbeat identify the exact source revision and hashes.
Control Center operation success comes from the exact structured child result, not ambient exit state.
News Projection generation and verification use one cross-runtime canonical receipt encoding.
Live Broadcast retries bounded backpressure without blocking the forecast cadence or inventing sequence gaps.
Preview remains read-only and cannot mutate production state or authorize Stable.
